QUOTE: "`ClientPosts.createPost` (`app/client/rest/posts.ts:43-47`) passes `noRetry: true`. In `app/client/rest/tracking.ts:383-385`, that sets `retryPolicyConfiguration = {retryLimit: 0}`." and "It is not retried automatically. The app makes exactly one send attempt"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly states the create-post request is never automatically retried (noRetry, retryLimit 0) and is sent exactly once.
